heard: A priest named Zechariah served the Lord, his wife Elizabeth from Aaron's line. Righteous and blameless in all their ways, yet barren and advanced in years. No child came to fill their home Waiting on God in silent prayer Blessed are you among women Blessed is the fruit of your womb The child leaped for joy inside Filled with the Holy Spirit now Blessed is she who believed that what the Lord said would be true The angel stood by the altar
